lede: The biggest thing on the docket this week is a special Telluride Medical Center board meeting Tuesday where trustees will consider engaging Jensen Partners to guide due diligence with CommonSpirit Health, one of the country's largest nonprofit hospital systems — a step that could signal a significant partnership or affiliation down the road. Also worth watching: the Ecology Commission takes up a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered lawn and garden equipment in town limits by 2028–2030, and the Norwood Board of Trustees digs into its 2027 draft budget. On the lighter side, Mountainfilm for Locals kicks off Tuesday at the library and Art Walk runs Friday.

notable.stake: Board votes on hiring advisors for potential CommonSpirit Health hospital partnership.
